notes.title: Enhanced Edition is coming to consoles
notes.notes:
Hello, 

I have recently been working on the console version of Anime vs Evil: Apocalypse. This version has been ported to Unreal Engine 5 with updated visuals and some other UI and gameplay improvements. You can already add the PS version to your wishlist, the Nintendo Switch version page will be available at a later date.

In addition, development on a new Anime vs Evil game will begin in the near time.

notes.title: Lovense Support
notes.notes:
Hello!

Promo link: https://www.lovense.com/p/AxyosGames


This update only applies to the DLC content. I worked with Lovense team to make the integration of thier devices to Anime vs Evil. You can now access the new control menu on the DLC maps (there is a tiny square at the bottom of the screen). If you like it I may be able to add this techology to the future games.

I know not many people are interested in this integration, not many people have these devices, but this is one way to advertise the game. Hopefully this move will help make an impact.

notes.title: Update #4.1
notes.notes:
Hello!

I just uploaded the update with the following fixes:
[list]
[*]Fixed sniper zoom when switching weapons/triggering an action window
[*]Improved zombies AI
[*]Improved dragon bosses AI
[*]Now you can start shooting/attack right from the sprint (this is mostly helping with the melee weapons)
[*]Level task highlight color is matching the minimap icon color
[*]Bonus spawn chance increased to 60%
[*]Fixed fire mage hit detection
[*]Fixed playback of zombie sounds
[*]Fixed reaper speed in easy mode
[*]The duration of the explosive ammo bonus has been increased
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42401716/a2148967a10ec209d53012dfad24625b72dc1af8.png[/img]

notes.title: Update #4
notes.notes:
Hey! Finally I finished with the update. You can find the changelist below:

[list]
[*]Added a new freezing ammo bonus
[*]Added new task types to collect items around the point
[*]Added new DLC content scenes
[*]Added a new attack type (throwing a rock) for regular zombies if you're above them
[*]Added an additional headshot hitmarker texture
[*]Added new animations for backwards movement
[*]Fixed melee combo attacks (you can hit enemy twice now when double clicking)
[*]Improved the gamepad button layout
[*]Added new reload animation for the "old" background characters
[*]Added the option to change the camera side offset
[*]Added the option to disable the random character thoughts
[*]Camera min/max distance increased
[*]Updated minimap icons
[*]Fix: The highlighted action button is now hidden when opening the minimap
[*]All items in the bonus shop are now unlimited in purchase (when you re-enter)
[*]Additional check for the "A good customer" achievement completion
[*]Fixed a rock mesh collision on the "movie" level
[*]The map icon matches the character you are playing as
[*]Added character rotation pointer and circle icon frame on the minimap
[*]Added shadowing for the minimap icons
[*]Added bonus golden pistols with x3 damage. They can be found in code containers, as well as in some places in the game levels
[*]Ammo bonuses cannot be picked up until you get a weapon
[*]Fixed navmesh on the first level
[*]Other small fixes
[/list]

notes.title: Anime vs Evil is finally released!
notes.notes:
Hello guys!

I worked on the Anime vs Evil closely until the release day. The game probably needs more time for promotion, but I didn't want to delay it any longer, as many of you asked for it to be released. I hope you appreciate the significant progress in the gameplay, relative to the previous game! Enjoy! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42401716/8ce85a293e22f0bc85fa0860d2b326b25c32aacd.jpg[/img]
